hero.headline: Charting Intelligent <highlight>Code Flows</highlight> for Enterprise Systems.
hero.subheadline: We engineer resilient custom software, autonomous AI workflows, and cloud infrastructure designed to scale your operational velocity.

capabilities.heading: Practical building blocks for autonomous enterprise systems.
capabilities.description: Four disciplines, one hands-on development practice — from model-driven agents to the infrastructure that keeps them running.
capabilities.card1Description: Autonomous workflows integrating LLMs into existing databases — retrieval-augmented, context-aware, and built to act on your operational data.
capabilities.card2Description: Microservices, Rust/Go backend engines, and low-latency APIs engineered for correctness at scale.
capabilities.card3Description: Complex n8n/Python orchestration eliminating manual overhead across your operational stack.
capabilities.card4Description: Kubernetes, AWS/GCP serverless setups with zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines built for resilience.

process.heading: From first call to production, in four steps.
process.description: No account managers, no sales layer — you talk to the people building your system, from the first call through launch and beyond.
process.step1Description: A short technical conversation — what you're trying to build, your existing stack, and where the real constraints are. No deck, no filler.
process.step2Description: We design the system, agree on the approach, then build in short iterations — you see working code early, not a big reveal at the end.
process.step3Description: Every system ships with tests and a CI/CD pipeline, deployed to your infrastructure or ours, monitored from day one.
process.step4Description: You work directly with the people who built it — no ticket queue. We stay involved after launch to fix, extend, and iterate as your needs change.

techStack.heading: The tools behind the work.
techStack.description: No framework worship — we pick what is correct for the problem and durable for your team to maintain.

globalReach.heading: Deploy close to your users, wherever they are.
globalReach.description: Multi-region cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP — low-latency deployments wherever your customers are, not just where our team sits.

projects.heading: Systems we integrate into your business.
projects.description: Not a portfolio — a set of proven capabilities. Each one is backed by something we've actually shipped and run in production.
projects.project1Description: Multi-language support built directly into your site — visitors browse in their own language, auto-detected on first visit, switchable anytime. This website runs on it: six languages, right now, in the header above.
projects.project2Description: Chat-based AI agents that answer questions, qualify leads, or guide visitors — deployable on a website, desktop, or as a dedicated app. Case study: our own AI assistant, shipped for desktop and Android.
projects.project3Description: QR-based digital menus for restaurants and cafés — customers scan and browse instantly, no app download, while you manage items and prices from a live dashboard. Case study: QR Menu, our own multi-tenant platform.
projects.project4Description: A booking system for service businesses — studios, salons, clinics — where customers reserve open slots in real time and you manage your calendar from one dashboard. Case study: Slotly, our own booking platform.

about.heading: A small, senior development practice.
about.paragraph1: Mogens Software is an independent software development practice focused on B2B systems: custom platforms, AI agents, and the infrastructure that keeps them running. No account managers, no bloated teams — you work directly with the people building your system.
about.paragraph2: Have a project in mind, a partnership idea, or just a question? Reach out directly, we read every message ourselves.
about.availability: Currently taking on a limited number of new projects

faq.heading: Questions we get before a project starts.
faq.description: If something's not covered here, ask directly — we read every message ourselves.
faq.q1Answer: Every project is scoped individually based on complexity and timeline — after the discovery call, we quote either a fixed price or a day rate, whichever fits the work. No hidden fees, no per-seat markup.
faq.q2Question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.q2Answer: It depends entirely on scope. A focused integration — a booking portal or a digital menu — can ship in a few weeks; a custom AI agent or multi-service backend takes longer. You get a realistic timeline after the discovery call, not before.
faq.q3Question: Who owns the code and IP once it's done?
faq.q3Answer: You do. Once the project is paid for, the code, infrastructure configuration, and any custom assets are entirely yours — no vendor lock-in, no rights retained on our side.
faq.q4Answer: Yes. If your project involves sensitive business logic or data, we're happy to sign one before any detailed discussion.
faq.q5Question: You're a small team — can you handle complex projects?
faq.q5Answer: We only take on what a small, senior team can execute well — that's a deliberate choice, not a limitation. You work directly with the people building your system instead of being routed through account managers and junior developers.
faq.q6Question: Do you provide support after launch?
faq.q6Answer: Yes — we stay involved after launch to fix, extend, and iterate as your needs change. There's no ticket queue; you reach us directly.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern engagements with Mogens Software and use of this website.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover two things: using this website, and engaging Mogens Software for development work. They're written in plain language on purpose — if anything here is unclear, ask us directly before signing anything.
terms.scopeBody: Every project is scoped individually. The specific deliverables, timeline, and price for your project are agreed in writing (email is fine) before work begins — these terms set the general ground rules, they don't replace that written agreement.
terms.engagementBody: Pricing is either a fixed project price or a day rate, agreed upfront per project as described in the FAQ. Payment terms (deposit, milestones, or on completion) are set per engagement in the written agreement, not by these terms alone.
terms.ipBody: Once a project is paid in full, the code, infrastructure configuration, and any custom assets built for that project are yours. We may reuse general-purpose tools, libraries, and know-how developed along the way in other projects, but not your specific business logic or data.
terms.confidentialityBody: We treat information you share about your business as confidential and don't disclose it to third parties. If your project needs a signed NDA before any detailed discussion, we're glad to sign one.
terms.liabilityBody: We build things carefully and test before deploying, but as with any software engagement, our liability for any claim arising from the work is limited to the amount paid for that specific engagement. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
terms.siteUseBody: The content on this site — text, design, and code — belongs to Mogens Software unless stated otherwise. You're welcome to browse, share links, and reach out through the contact form; automated scraping or republishing the content elsewhere without permission isn't.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
terms.changesBody: If these terms change, we'll update the date at the top of this page. Changes won't apply retroactively to an already-agreed engagement.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Reach us at <link>{email}</link>.

privacy.metaDescription: How Mogens Software collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Mogens Software collects through this website, why we collect it, and how you can control it. We built this site to be honest about it: we collect the minimum needed to respond to your audit request, nothing more.
privacy.collectBody: When you submit the audit request form, we collect the information you type in: your name, work email, company name, and a description of what you want to build. We do not collect this data anywhere else on the site — there are no other forms, and we do not track you across other sites.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use Vercel Analytics to understand aggregate traffic (pages viewed, approximate location by country, referrers). It does not use cookies and does not collect personally identifiable information.
privacy.whyBody: Solely to respond to your audit request — to understand what you are looking to build and get back to you within one business day, as promised on the form.
privacy.processedBody: Form submissions are sent as an email via <link>Resend</link>, our email delivery provider, to our inbox. Resend processes the message on our behalf and does not use your data for any purpose of its own. The site itself is hosted on Vercel.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep audit request emails only as long as needed to respond to you and maintain a basic business record of the conversation. If you would like your data deleted sooner, contact us and we will remove it.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask us what data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it, at any time. We do not sell your data or share it with anyone beyond the processors named above.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about your data? Reach us at <link>{email}</link>.
